messages:
maya_customer: Hey team, after updating our app we started getting 404s when calling chat methods via the official Node TS SDK. curl against the API works fine. Any idea?

alex_support: Sorry to hear that—can you paste the exact SDK call + package version? Also any request/response logs would help.

maya_customer: Using `@redwood/inference` v0.21.3 (we pinned in package.json). Node 18. Example: 
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-lite', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'hi' }], sessionId: 's-123' });
```
Response from SDK: 404 Not Found.

alex_support: Thanks. Can you run `DEBUG=rw:* node reproduce.js` and paste logs? Also does a simple curl to the same endpoint succeed for you?

maya_customer: curl to `https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat.create` returns 200 with expected body. SDK log shows it's calling `/v1/chat/create` (note the slash instead of dot) and returns 404. Here's log snippet: 
```
rw:outbound Request POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/create +12ms
rw:outbound 404 Not Found +8ms
```

alex_support: hmm. That looks like an SDK routing bug—possibly older SDK code paths. @jorge_devex can you confirm if route naming changed recently?

jorge_devex: I think the canonical API route is `POST /v1/chat.create` (dot) and we introduced an alias last year, but we removed legacy path `/v1/chat/create` in api-service v2.1. Most clients were updated in v0.22.0. If you're on v0.21.x, the SDK still emits the old path.

maya_customer: ah okay. We pinned because of semver breaks earlier. But curl to the dot path works because server still accepts `chat.create` at top-level. Why does curl succeed for me when sdk gets 404?

alex_support: Two possibilities: 1) Your curl is hitting a different routing layer (regional/proxy) that still rewrites old path, 2) Your SDK is configured to use an internal endpoint override. Maya, can you paste `RW_API_BASE` or any env overrides?

maya_customer: No overrides. Env is empty.

maya_customer: Also noticed param name mismatch—SDK expects `sessionId` but API now expects `conversation_id`. With old path it might have accepted either. Example API curl using new name: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat.create -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-lite","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"conversation_id":"s-123"}'
```

priya_eng_oncall: Confirming: we shipped API change that prefers `conversation_id` over `sessionId` and removed the legacy `/v1/chat/create` route in the latest infra rollout (rolled to prod at 2026-02-18 03:22 UTC). We kept a short compatibility shim but it was removed in the recent GC sweep.

maya_customer: So what's the recommended fix? Update to SDK v0.22.x? Any risk of breaking changes?

jorge_devex: Yes, upgrade to `@redwood/inference@^0.22.2`. Changelog: switched internal router to dot-paths, normalized param names (sessionId -> conversation_id), and added transparent fallbacks for a week after deploy. There was a patch release last week to restore a missing fallback.

alex_support: If you can't upgrade right away, quick workaround: call the REST endpoint directly with the new body key `conversation_id` (instead of using SDK helper), or patch your package.json to allow ^0.21.0 -> ^0.22.2 and run `npm update`.

maya_customer: We tried `npm update` but CI was still pulling 0.21.3 due to a lockfile. We're running in a monorepo with pnpm — will need an internal change. Any chance you can temporarily re-enable the old route or add a shim?

priya_eng_oncall: I can re-enable a temporary compatibility shim for your org for 48 hours if you open a support escalation with the tenant id. But it's better to patch the client asap. Re-enabling global legacy paths isn't recommended because it undermines the rollout.

maya_customer: Ok opening escalation now. Also curious about retries: our app did several retries and double-billed tokens during the window. Is that expected?

alex_support: If the SDK saw 404 it shouldn't charge. The double-billing risk usually happens with 5xx + retries where the request actually executed. Can you paste the billing invoice lines or request ids? We can correlate.

maya_customer: Putting invoice snippet in the escalation ticket. For now we'll try to update to 0.22.2 in a branch and report back. Thanks for triage. :pray:

pkg-bot: Published @redwood/inference v0.22.2 — includes route fixes and param rename helpers (2026-03-01T14:03:12Z).

jorge_devex: Note for internal: Need to add clearer migration notes in release notes and add automatic migration warning in console when apps call deprecated routes. Filing follow-up: INF-8123.

alex_support: Great. Maya — reach back here after upgrade or if you want the temporary shim. We'll keep the thread open. :thumbsup:
